AiBriefHttpRequest.description: What the console may send: the stage and, for disputes, which case. Session facts are never caller input.

AupCategorySignalResponse.description: Optional Channel3 signal shown next to the AUP result; it never changes the rule decision.

CaseRouteResponse.description: Fuzzy case routing: which goods group (and so which dispute items) applies. Code decides; advisory only.

ConnectionsResponse.description: Deployment mode only. Never a key, a key's presence, a value or a variable name.

CountryRulesCheckRequest.description: Seller and buyer countries plus closed choices; no free text reaches the check.

ErrorBody.description: The error body every refusal uses.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason, for example session_required.

message.description: A plain sentence for a person.

GuideFormRequest.description: One field ({item, value}) or one round of up to three fields ({fields: [...]}), never both.

ProductCard.description: A Channel3 catalogue product reduced to what identifies the item; no prices, offers or buy links.

ProductConfirmResponse.description: The seller's own choice: one of the cards they were shown, or none of them.

ProductReferenceResponse.description: Up to three Channel3 products for the seller to pick from; advisory, never changes the AUP decision.

SendGuard.description: (r25 send guard) What a send carries and to whom, side by side; every account id is masked (first 2, last 4).

SentFileFingerprint.description:
Plain SHA-256 of one file's exact bytes, recorded at the moment of a send so a later read-back can be compared.

The keyed ``payload_sha256`` cannot be checked outside the session; this one can. Never present on a preview.

SyntheticMoney.description: Same shape as the PayPal Disputes `dispute_amount` (ProviderMoney below); values are synthetic.

WebhookEventProjection.description: All that is kept after a SUCCESS: identifiers and status only, no amounts, payer data, links or summary.

DemoCsrf.description: CSRF token for the same session. Get it from the csrf_token field of the response to POST /api/v1/demo/sessions. Every POST also needs it; without it the API answers 403 csrf_rejected.
DemoCsrf.name: X-CSRF-Token

DemoSession.description: Demo session id. Get it from the session_id field of the response to POST /api/v1/demo/sessions (that request needs no header). Without it the API answers 401 session_required.
DemoSession.name: X-Demo-Session

info.description: API of the local TradeGlot console (127.0.0.1:8000). It uses synthetic data, expects the demo session headers the console sets, and the hosted demo answers 503 on every route that would reach PayPal. Authentication: create a session with POST /api/v1/demo/sessions, then send X-Demo-Session on every other call and X-CSRF-Token on every POST. POST calls also need an Origin header equal to the console's own origin (browsers add it; scripts must set it), otherwise the API answers 403 origin_required.
info.summary: Read-only rule checks and a gated evidence workflow for small PayPal sellers, on synthetic data.
info.title: TradeGlot Local Console
